lihaila-hitpost-skill-hitpost.description: Write X (Twitter) posts that earn attention and sound human, using the writing rules from HitPost (lihaila.si). The skill turns an idea, topic, link or rough note into three ready-to-post drafts with different angles (single post, thread or long Premium post, in any tone or language), checks their length the way X counts it, and gives one-click share links. It can also polish and score an existing draft. Use it whenever the user wants to write, draft, rewrite, improve or punch up a tweet, X post, thread or 🧵, or a gm/greeting post, or asks "what should I tweet about…", even if they don't say…

lihaila-hitpost-skill-hitpost-pro.description: Run HitPost (lihaila.si) from your AI agent. It writes X (Twitter) posts, threads, long posts and X Articles from live research (Grok reads what X is saying this week, Brave checks the web and news), polishes drafts with a blind multi-model judge, and posts them to the user's own X account. Uses the user's HitPost account and credits through an API key. Use it whenever the user has a HitPost account or key, mentions HitPost Pro, or wants live X research, an X Article, or a post published to X from the agent, even if they don't say "HitPost".
